entities.name: Svetozár Hurban-Vajanský
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Svetozár Miloslav Hurban, pen name Svetozár Hurban-Vajanský, was a Slovak poet, lawyer and nationalist newspaper editor who was twice imprisoned. Born in Hlboké, he was the son of Jozef Miloslav Hurban.
